_doc: REPO ORDERS — THE HOOK, ENDLESS. The LONGHORN app pushes a recovery order at a quiet moment: a debtor's name, a car on a curb, an amount outstanding, and PAPER that is clean 80% of the time. Drive out, meet the person whose car it is, and decide. Hook it and you get paid; walk away and the app marks your rating. 20% of orders are BAD PAPER — a fake lien, a note written yesterday, a dead account — and those carry a TELL in the push that the debtor confirms to your face. The debtors are never the joke. The paperwork is. Read once at boot by scripts/systems/repo_orders.gd.
plead_lines: I've got it Friday. Friday. I already told the app Friday.
That's my daughter's car seat in the back. Let me get the car seat out.
I'm not gonna fight you. I just need somebody to write down that I was standing here.
Two payments. I missed two payments in nine years and here you are.
I work the line off the Loop. No car, no shift. No shift, no payment. You see it?
They moved the due date. Same account, new date, no letter. I checked twice.
My mother's oxygen is in that trunk. Ninety seconds. That's all I'm asking.
You're just the guy they send. I know. I used to be the guy they send.
I called the number on the notice. It played me a song and then it hung up.
Take it. I'm tired. Just don't scratch the tailgate — it was my dad's.
Can you tell them an actual person was out here? That's it. That's the whole favor.
I can have it current by the fifteenth. I've got that in writing somewhere in the house.
offer_lines: Two hundred cash and you never saw this truck.
Two hundred in your pocket and the app says you drove right past.
There's two hundred in the glovebox. Nobody on this street is watching.
Two hundred says your paperwork gets real confusing tonight.
Two hundred, and I'll have it at the lot myself by Monday. My word on it.
Two hundred. That's grocery money and I'm still standing here offering it.
fight_lines: No. Not this one. Not today.
Step off the truck. I'm asking you nice, and I'm asking once.
You put that hook on it and you and me are gonna have a real conversation.
I built that engine in my daddy's driveway. Back up.
Everybody takes something off me. Not you. Not tonight.
Put it down and walk. Please. I'm saying please.
bad_paper_lines: I'm four days late, not four months. Who told you four months?
That lien's from a company that's been dead since 2019. I've got the letter inside.
My account's at Cattleman's Trust. They closed my branch. They closed everybody's branch.
The note on that truck got written yesterday. Yesterday. I never signed a thing.
You got a VIN on that order? No? Then whose car are you taking?
My husband passed in March. That car's in probate and your app knows it.
Longhorn Dynamics isn't a company. I looked it up. It's a P.O. box off the tollway.
I paid that off in June. The receipt's in the house. Let me go get the receipt.

app_void: ORDER {id} VOIDED — VEHICLE NOT LOCATED. This affects your rating.
app_offer_void: ORDER {id} VOIDED — VEHICLE NOT LOCATED. This affects your rating.

app_missed_quota: Yesterday's numbers are visible to the region.
app_hooked: ORDER {id} ON THE HOOK. Impound is expecting it. Do not stop for food.
promo_lines: PROMOTION PROCESSED. Your new rate is live in the app. Your old rate is not.
You are a {rank} now. That is a title, not a raise, but the multiplier is real.
Bolo Capital notes your throughput and has adjusted its expectations upward.
RANK {rank} UNLOCKED. A regional manager was notified and did not respond.
{rank}. The dental is still coming. Keep an eye on the app.
_tuning: first_gap 12 s of QUIET (not 12 s of clock) so a new player meets the loop inside a minute of leaving the menu; under 8 s and the first push lands before the wrecker is straight. order_gap 40 + 0..20 keeps roughly 1 order per 60 s of quiet driving — the Hook should feel endless, not nagging. min_m 120 guarantees a drive (under 90 and the order spawns in your mirror); max_m 450 is the far edge of the seven-street grid. bad_paper_chance 0.20 is the whole moral system's dial: at 0.35 the player stops reading pushes and starts refusing everything, at 0.10 nobody ever notices a tell. debtor_range 25 m makes the person appear while you are still deciding, never after the hook. expire_seconds 240 real seconds ~= 6 in-game minutes at sky_weather's 24 h / 600 s. Pay: sedan 300 / pickup 450 base x (1 + 0.5 x haul/400) x rank (1.00..1.60) = $300 worst case to $1,080 at PARTNER on a long pickup haul; repo_board's own junker pays 250-450 flat, so an order should always beat the board. offer_amount 200 is deliberately LESS than any delivery: taking the cash is a moral choice, never an optimal one.
